Agentic RAG
Product Specific Branding
How to Use it

The Progress brand—whether it stands alone or works in tandem with specific products—is our reputation. It precedes us in every relationship we have and is demonstrated in every action we take. Our brand is what people think about before engaging with us, and the sum of the experiences they have with us after they do so.

For Agentic RAG, we can keep these experiences consistent by always adhering to these product-specific guidelines.

Keep in mind that, we should always use the Progress Visual Brand Identity guidelines as our primary benchmark—with the addition of dedicated design elements for Agentic RAG.

Logos

The Agentic RAG logo follows Progress product architecture where we add the product name to the Progress logo using our corporate font, Progress Sans. The logo is available in both horizontal and stacked layouts and is a recognizable signature and emblem for the business. It is distinct and should be applied consistently to build recognition and credibility. Always use the Agentic RAG logo as supplied.

Use the stacked logo only when space is too limited to use the horizontal logo correctly.

When needed, to support accessibility best practices, you can use the black and white version of the logo.

Positioning

The sub-brand name sits left aligned to the "P" in Progress with a distance equal to the height of the "x."

Clear Space

Each sub-brand brandmark has a clear space to prevent it from being crowded by other visual elements. The clear space is based on the height of the symbol.

Minimum Size

To avoid poor reproduction on screen and print, the brandmark should appear no smaller than 75px or 0.85 inches in height.

Colors

The unique color palette of Agentic RAG is focused around a core set of blues and green colors. These colors lend Agentic RAG a specific brand identity and should always be used as the predominant colors in the design. They can be supplemented with the Progress palette colors as needed for additional accents in illustrations.

Agentic RAG Hex Loop

This ready-to-use element is a hexagon shape inspired by the Progress logo shape and its isometric 30° grid. We call it Hex Loop. Similar to the logo, the ever-continuous loop connotes self-optimization and innovation.

The Agentic RAG Hex Loop uses its primary dark blues. Please refer to the Progress Visual Brand Identity guidelines for additional instructions on use in layouts.

The Hex Loop is always used as a cropped element and NEVER in full when in layout.

NEVER CHANGE THE COLOR OF THE HEX LOOP!
THE HEX LOOP IS ALWAYS USED AS A CROPPED ELEMENT AND NEVER USED IN FULL WHEN IN LAYOUT.

By using part of the Hex Loop in your layout, you can emphasize the Progress brand while adding visual interest to a layout. The diagram below shows examples of how to use a crop, or part, of the Hex Loop in design. These are just examples—be sure to use the best option in your design based on content, orientation or other attributes applicable to the layout.
